notes: X-axis label of the headwind-profile chart in HKO's Chinese windshear/turbulence pamphlet, a born-digital PDF whose diagrams are pasted rasters. Pixels-only check: eye_read with NO ocr returns page 1's COMPLETE text layer (1401 chars, read in full); it contains the surrounding prose but no axis labels. ocr:true gives ocr_images=10 and the label appears on two separate chart images (p01_09.jpeg windshear, p01_12.jpeg turbulence). CAVEAT for the maintainer: the search engine returns windshear_c.pdf itself in the top 3 (indexed via its text layer), but the ground-truth string is not surfaced in any snippet; the indexed text layer provably lacks it, so the answer is still only obtainable from pixels. Note also that a Doppler-radar phrase OCR'd from p01_02.jpeg WAS rejected as a candidate because it does occur in the text layer.
